relationships.subject: Hydromorphone
relationships.evidence_quote: Hyd repressed NLRP3 inflammasome-mediated pyroptosis of AMs after CPB treatment.

relationships.subject: Hydromorphone
relationships.evidence_quote: Hyd upregulated Nrf2/HO-1 expression levels to repress NLRP3 inflammasome-mediated pyroptosis.

relationships.subject: Nrf2/HO-1 pathway
relationships.evidence_quote: Hyd alleviated NLRP3 inflammasome-mediated pyroptosis and CPB-induced ALI via upregulating the Nrf2/HO-1 pathway

relationships.subject: Hydromorphone
relationships.evidence_quote: Hyd attenuated CPB-induced lung injury as manifested by reductions in lung inflammation and edema

key_findings: Hydromorphone attenuated CPB-induced lung injury in rats and repressed NLRP3 inflammasome-mediated pyroptosis of alveolar macrophages.
The protective effect depended on Nrf2/HO-1 upregulation, reversed by nigericin or ML385.
